subject: NimbusAI security onboarding — prefill checklist & scope clarifications
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sam Patel <sam.patel@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-02-07T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo: security kickoff & prefill checklist

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for a productive demo earlier. Per our call, I’m starting the security onboarding thread so we can get a SIG/CAIQ prefilling process underway and clarify a few scope items that will speed up evidence collection. Can you please confirm the best contact for the security intake (engineering or procurement)?

Quick recap of what we discussed and what we need from NimbusAI upfront:
- SOC 2: you mentioned a Type II in progress with expected report delivery in Q2 2027 — can you confirm target month and whether we can get the interim controls letter?
- Data residency: primary tenant region is US (us-west) but you noted some EU customers — do you have EU regions pinned or separate projects that require EU residency?
- Regulated data: is PHI in scope for any workflows we’ll serve in the POC?
- Preferred questionnaire: would a CAIQ-prefill work for your team, or do you prefer a custom SIG-lite we can tailor to the integration surface?

Next steps I propose:
1) I’ll attach a CAIQ-prefill template with the fields we can prefill from Redwood (see attachment)
2) If Nimbus prefers custom questions, please send the form or tell us which sections to prioritize (dataflow, key mgmt, encryption in transit/rest, access controls)
3) We’ll assign evidence owners on our side and propose a 3-week turnaround for the initial bundle (shorter if you can accept partial evidence)

Attachments: nimbusai-sig-prefill.xlsx (prefill template), redwood-dataflow-diagram-v2.pdf

If you can reply with the intake owner and your SOC 2 target month, I’ll get the prefills moving.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122
[Attachment: nimbusai-sig-prefill.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: redwood-dataflow-diagram-v2.pdf (pdf)]

Date: 2027-02-07T12:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: security kickoff & prefill checklist

Marcus —

Thanks for the recap and the template. Quick answers:
- Intake owner: I’m looping in Legal Ops (legalops@nimbus.ai) and our Head of Platform, Priya Desai — legalops is the starting point for questionnaires.
- SOC 2: we are targeting May 2027 for Type II. We can provide an interim controls summary this week.
- Data residency: primary infra is us-west; we have a European deployment for two customers (EU region is available but not yet enabled for your project).
- PHI: not in scope for the initial POC.
- Questionnaire: CAIQ prefill is perfect — saves us time. If Redwood can prefill the standard control mappings and mark items that need evidence, that’s ideal.

We’ll review your attachments and Legal Ops will confirm the evidence owner for each section. Expect a short-form response from us by EOD tomorrow.

Sam
Director of Product Partnerships | NimbusAI
sam.patel@nimbus.ai

Sam / Legal Ops —

Great, thanks for the quick confirmations. A couple small clarifying asks from our side to make the prefilling precise:

1) SOC 2 interim controls: if you can drop the interim controls summary into the Google Drive link I shared (or reply here), we’ll map controls that are already covered vs. those that need evidence.
2) EU residency: are those EU customers using a separate tenant/project or the same tenant with localized routing? If separate, we’ll exclude EU-resident data from the initial CAIQ scope unless you ask otherwise.
3) TLS / key mgmt: does Nimbus use KMS (AWS KMS / Cloud KMS) for customer key material today, or are keys managed in-app? A single line answer helps (e.g., "AWS KMS for all prod keys").
4) Access requests / logs: for the POC we typically provide access logs and a short retention summary — what retention window does Legal Ops prefer for audit logs (90/180/365 days)?

Proposed timeline: once we have intake owner and interim SOC2 note, Redwood will prefill CAIQ and return a marked-up CAIQ within 4 business days. If Legal Ops wants a walkthrough, we can schedule a 30-minute session the same week.

Cheers —
Marcus
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: security kickoff & prefill checklist — follow-ups

All —

Couple of follow-ups from the security team side:
- Evidence granularity: we will prefill control statements and upload sample artifacts (policy extracts, architecture diagrams). For anything requiring logs, we’ll ask for redacted samples only.
- KMS: confirm whether Nimbus uses AWS KMS or an HSM — if you use a customer-managed HSM, call that out so we can adjust the key management questions.
- Audit log retention: default to 90 days unless Legal requires a longer window. If Legal Ops needs 365, we can flag those controls for extended retention.

Action items:
- Marcus: prepare CAIQ prefilling and mark controls that require evidence (in progress).
- Sam / Legal Ops: share interim SOC 2 control summary + confirm KMS approach (by EOD tomorrow).
- Marissa: I'll loop you in on evidence upload instructions and naming conventions for the Drive folder.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
